items.prompt: Starting with three fourths… …we’ve seen that to write an equivalent fraction with twenty on the bottom… 3/4 ▢/20 …an equation like this one will help us. 3/4 × ▢/▢ = ▢/20 Next, to make an equivalent fraction, this must have a value of 1. So top and bottom must be the same. But what number should we write on top and bottom? To answer that we ask this: four times what is equal to twenty?
items.demo: Four times *five* is equal to twenty. So we write five here... and here… 3/4 × 5/5 = ▢/20
